            acc = -p[0]*xx - p[1]*xx**3 - p[2]*vv
        elif form == 'cubic_lin':
            acc = -p[0]*xx**3 - p[1]*vv
        elif form == 'duff_lin_p5':
            acc = -p[0]*xx - p[1]*xx**3 - p[2]*xx**5 - p[3]*vv
        elif form == 'duff_v3':
            acc = -p[0]*xx - p[1]*xx**3 - p[2]*vv**3
        elif form == 'duff_vv':
            acc = -p[0]*xx - p[1]*xx**3 - p[2]*vv*np.abs(vv)
        elif form == 'duff_x2v':
            acc = -p[0]*xx - p[1]*xx**3 - p[2]*vv - p[3]*xx**2*vv
        elif form == 'duff_xv':
            acc = -p[0]*xx - p[1]*xx**3 - p[2]*vv - p[3]*xx*vv
        elif form == 'duff_v3abs':
            acc = -p[0]*xx - p[1]*xx**3 - p[2]*vv**3*np.abs(vv)
        elif form == 'pend_lin':
            acc = -p[0]*np.sin(xx) - p[1]*vv
        elif form == 'duff_lin_c' :
            acc = -p[0]*xx - p[1]*xx**3 - p[2]*vv - p[3]
        return [vv, acc]
    return rhs

def fit(form, p0, bounds=(-np.inf, np.inf), nsub=1):
    rhs = make_rhs(form)
    def resid(p):
        sol = solve_ivp(rhs, (t0, t1), [x0, v0], t_eval=teval[::nsub],
                        args=(p,), rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-12, method='RK45')
        if sol.y.shape[1] != len(teval[::nsub]):
            return np.ones(len(teval[::nsub]))*1e3
        return sol.y[0] - xobs[::nsub]
    r = least_squares(resid, p0, bounds=bounds, xtol=1e-14, ftol=1e-14, gtol=1e-14)
    mse = np.mean(r.fun**2)
    return mse, r.x
